question: I paid cash into a Vancouver bus farebox and got a paper transfer. Can I use that paper transfer at a SkyTrain gate?
generated_answer: 1. Yes, you can use a paper transfer from a Vancouver bus farebox at a SkyTrain gate. 2. The paper transfer is valid for a certain period of time (usually 90 minutes) and can be used to transfer between buses and SkyTrain. 3. To use the transfer at a SkyTrain gate, simply insert the paper transfer into the fare gate reader. 4. If the transfer is still valid, the gate will open and you can proceed to the platform. 5. Make sure to keep the transfer until you complete your journey, as you may need to show it to a transit operator if requested. 6. Note that paper transfers are not valid for use on West Coast Express trains or for purchasing a DayPass. 7. If you have a Compass Card, you can also use it to pay for your bus fare and transfer to SkyTrain without needing a paper transfer. 8. If you have any issues using the paper transfer at a SkyTrain gate, you can ask for assistance from a transit operator or visit a customer service centre for help. 9. It's always a good idea to check the TransLink website or mobile app for the most up-to-date information on transfers and fare rules. 10. Enjoy your trip on Vancouver's public transit system!
